name: Developer Handoff
producesProse: The exported package, sliced per role, including the runbook and its evidence.

exitCriteria.describe: Each assigned team member can start their part without coming back to ask a question.
The handoff's operational actions are enumerated and every runbook step rests on an assertion at or above the threshold; no operational actions is n/a with a reason, not satisfied (#57).
No unresolved critical questions remain. CRITICAL, per DEC-0014: the question blocks active handoff content, or makes a handoff criterion unevaluable.

purpose: Hand each assigned person a slice they can start from without coming back to ask.

method.summary: Slice per role, rest every runbook step on an assertion at or above threshold, and clear the critical questions.
steps: Read the task set, the acceptance criteria and the evidence behind them.
Enumerate the handoff's operational actions; if there are none, state why before proposing n/a for `runbook-steps-above-threshold`.
Author one runbook step per action, each resting on an assertion at or above the threshold (#57); the handoff projects the aggregate runbook from those steps (DEC-0011).

Classify every new step with `actionClass`: `informational` when it only inspects and changes nothing, `mutating` when it changes state that can be put back, `destructive` when it can destroy something. The class decides the rung the step's assertions must reach under the project's `confidence.thresholds`; tags and wording do not.
Do not create a typed `runbook` or substitute another type for one; DEC-0011 keeps it deactivated until a multi-step destructive procedure needs rollback state that spans steps.
Read the stage Working notes to obtain its revision, then append or replace the named `developer-runbook` subsection with the rendered Markdown runbook and role-slice instructions.
Delegate to the planning specialist where a slice needs its steps written for a role.
Slice the package per assigned role and check that each slice stands on its own.
Resolve every critical question, or ask the operator to settle it (DEC-0014).
Link each step's evidence to the step it supports.

In the `runbook-steps-above-threshold` attestation, name each active runbook step and the derived rung beneath it; if there are no operational actions, record n/a with the reason instead of satisfied.
Ask the operator to confirm the attestation, record an attestation against each exit criterion, then exit.

nextActivity.rule: Resolve a critical question first; delegate to planning when a role slice needs its steps written; author or revise while any slice is incomplete or any step rests below the threshold; attest once every exit criterion holds; exit only after attestation.
constraints: A step resting on an assertion below the threshold does not ship (#57).
An empty operational-action set is recorded n/a with a reason; it never satisfies a universal claim vacuously.
Runbook membership and order are derived from runbook-step links and ordinals; they are not copied into an aggregate artifact (DEC-0011).
A question that blocks active handoff content, or makes a handoff criterion unevaluable, is critical (DEC-0014).

approvalBoundary.approves: That each role slice can be started without coming back to ask.
requires: The operator confirms the exact stage attestation or advance through Kiln's interactive confirmation channel during that invocation.

completionSummary.format: A concise Markdown handoff with bullets under Completed, Decisions, Open items, and Next activity.
includes: Each role slice and what it contains.
The steps and the assertions underneath them.
Questions closed as non-critical, and why.
